title: Circular No. (26/2/3406) dated 10/2/2026 regarding acceptance of the Digital Identity through the Sanad application
text:
Number: 26/2/3406
Date: 22 Sha'ban 1447 AH
Corresponding to: 10 February 2026 AD
Circular to:
All Banks Operating in the Kingdom
After Greetings,
I hereby reiterate to all banks operating in the Kingdom the necessity of
compliance regarding the acceptance of the Digital Identity through the 'Sanad'
application as an alternative to the traditional personal identification card. This
Digital Identity must be accredited locally for all transactions at the bank's
headquarters and across all branches operating in the Kingdom, in coordination with
the Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship and in accordance with the
established procedures.
Best Regards
Governor
Dr. Adel Al- Sharkas
